head.h1: Corporate Meal Prep Catering in Dubai — What It Costs and How to Book

opening_paragraph: Corporate meal prep catering in Dubai from myCHEF starts at AED 700 per person and keeps your team fed with fresh, individually-portioned meals cooked to a set weekly schedule. A vetted chef designs the menu, cooks and portions every meal, and delivers on time — so nobody loses an hour to lunch runs or a scramble for options. Tell us your headcount and dietary mix, we typically reply within 15 minutes during business hours, with an itemised proposal to follow.

replace_in_block.new_heading: What corporate meal prep catering includes
new_paragraphs: Corporate meal prep catering covers everything from menu design to labelled, ready-to-eat meals delivered to your office. As a corporate meal prep caterer in Dubai, myCHEF plans a rotating menu around your team's tastes and diets, cooks in a licensed kitchen, portions each meal into individual containers with clear labels, and delivers on a fixed daily or weekly rhythm. A typical programme includes a private corporate meal prep chef assigned to your account, a signed-off menu cycle, allergen and calorie labelling, chilled delivery, and a single point of contact for changes. Because meals arrive plated and portioned, there is no on-site cooking, no clutter and no cleanup for your facilities team. It is the difference between a one-off drop-off and a dependable service your people can plan their day around, week after week.

replace_in_block.new_heading: Corporate meal prep menu and options
new_paragraphs: The corporate meal prep menu in Dubai is built as a rotating cycle so no one gets bored of the same three dishes. A standard week mixes lean proteins, wholegrains, fresh salads and a rotating hot main, with vegetarian, vegan, halal and lighter calorie-controlled tracks running alongside the core menu. Food is designed to travel and reheat well — nothing that turns soggy or dries out by 1pm. You can run a single shared menu or let staff pick from two or three daily options, and dietary flags (gluten-free, dairy-free, nut-free, keto) are handled meal by meal instead of as an afterthought. Menus rotate seasonally and can lean into whatever your team asks for, from Mediterranean bowls to Levantine mezze to comfort classics. Everything is agreed with you before the first delivery, then refined as feedback comes in.

new_paragraphs: We deliver corporate meal prep catering across Dubai — from Business Bay, DIFC and Downtown offices to Dubai Marina, JLT, Media City and the free-zone campuses. Searching for corporate meal prep catering near me usually points here because we cover the whole city on one standard, adjusting delivery windows to your building and access rules. Explore office catering or weekly meal prep , and see the wider corporate catering and catering in Dubai range for events that go beyond the daily lunch.

add_block.new_heading: Corporate meal prep catering for offices, events and teams
new_paragraphs: The service flexes from a small startup floor to a multi-department headquarters, and it scales up for one-off needs too. Most clients use corporate meal prep catering services in Dubai for daily staff lunches — a reliable, healthy alternative to delivery apps that keeps the team on site and productive. It also works for shift teams who need meals ready at odd hours, for wellness programmes that reward staff with proper food, and for onboarding weeks when new hires eat together. When you have a bigger moment, the same corporate meal prep catering for events in Dubai covers offsites, training days, town halls and away-days, and can slot into a corporate meal prep party catering setup for a Friday team lunch or a project-launch spread. One caterer, one standard, whether it is five desks or five hundred.

For companies that want a home-catering-style touch for executives or remote leadership, individual meal prep can be delivered to home addresses alongside the office run, keeping one menu and one invoice across the whole team.

new_paragraphs: How much does corporate meal prep catering cost in Dubai?

It starts from around AED 700 per person and is quoted by headcount, menu tier and how many meals per week you need. Standing weekly programmes are priced per programme and cost less per meal than one-off orders.
What is included in a corporate meal prep programme?

Included is menu design, an assigned vetted chef, individually-portioned and labelled meals, chilled delivery on a set schedule, and one contact for changes. There is no on-site cooking or cleanup for your team.
Can you handle dietary requirements and allergies?

Yes — vegetarian, vegan, halal, gluten-free, dairy-free, nut-free and calorie-controlled tracks run alongside the core menu. Requirements are captured once at setup, labelled on every container, and carried through each cycle.
Do you deliver daily or weekly?

Both — you choose a daily delivery window, a few days a week, or a batch you store and reheat. The schedule is fixed at setup so your reception can rely on it, with room for last-minute headcount changes.
How do I hire or set up a regular arrangement?

Share your headcount, dietary mix and delivery days; we send a proposed menu cycle and an itemised proposal, usually within one business day. Most companies start with a two-week trial before committing.
Can you deliver to home addresses as well as the office?
Yes — for executives or remote staff we can deliver individual corporate meal prep to home addresses alongside the office run, keeping one menu and one invoice across the whole team.
Is there a minimum headcount or commitment?

Programmes flex from a small floor to a large headquarters, and you can scale meals up or down week to week or pause for holidays. We will recommend a sensible starting point once we know your team size.
For corporate meal prep catering, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .
